about:
Italy in 1440, between the Peace of Ferrara and the Peace of Lodi: Milan and Venice at war for Lombardy, with Florence, the Pope and
the condottiere Francesco Sforza on Venice's side; Alfonso of Aragon fighting René of Anjou for Naples; a Pope who had fled Rome for
Florence. 20 states, from Naples' ten settlements to free cities of one, and a single outsider, on a small map of 71. Winning is
reuniting Italy: two thirds of it — four centuries before it happened.

achievements.name: The Iron Crown
achievements.desc: Proclaim the Kingdom of Italy, with Rome, Milan and half the peninsula.

achievements.name: Duke of Milan
achievements.desc: As Sforza's March, hold Milan — Francesco Sforza made himself its duke in 1450.

achievements.name: The Magnanimous
achievements.desc: As Aragon, hold Naples before 1443 — Alfonso entered it in June 1442.

achievements.name: Grand Duke
achievements.desc: As Florence, proclaim the Grand Duchy of Tuscany, as Cosimo I did in 1569.

achievements.name: The Warrior Pope
achievements.desc: As the Pope, proclaim the States of the Church — Julius II won them back in armour.

achievements.name: Beyond the Adda
achievements.desc: As Venice, hold Milan — the Republic's armies stood at its gates in 1448.

achievements.name: Libertas
achievements.desc: As Lucca, still free in your own city at the end — the word on the republic's banner, which it kept until Napoleon.

achievements.name: The Wolf of Rimini
achievements.desc: As Rimini, take Urbino: Sigismondo Malatesta's feud with Federico da Montefeltro.

achievements.name: Two Sicilies
achievements.desc: Proclaim the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
